knowledge_scope: One brand only. This file covers every currently known and researched fact for Pixi Grow. The internal record confirms the name and onboarding note, but the exact business category, owner, location, official social page and service catalogue are not safely established. The file is designed to prevent identity mixing while still supporting brand-introduction and asset-led content.
